steps.title: General stat recommendations for Inferno. — …
steps.text: General stat recommendations for Inferno. — 95+ Ranged — 90+ Defense — 95+ Magic

steps.title: (Optional) Do some kills at The …
steps.text: (Optional) Do some kills at The Hueycoatl for Huasca seeds to make 1-2 Prayer regeneration potions for your setup.

steps.title: Kill vorkath to get a Vorkath's …
steps.text: Kill vorkath to get a Vorkath's head. — This can be used on a Ranging cape to store the enhanced ammo saving effect if you have that. — If you are experienced, you might be able to get a Dizana's quiver instead. — Use your hasta to melee him. — Remember you can get to the boss quickly by taking your Lunar Isle teleport in your poh, then talking to a citizen to get kicked from the island.

steps.title: Complete the Inferno. — Inferno is …
steps.text: Complete the Inferno. — Inferno is a safe death, so you can keep your other items in death storage. — Adjust the setup to your preference.

steps.title: Depending on your future goals, you …
steps.text: Depending on your future goals, you may now be ready to drop your ring of suffering. — Make sure you have plenty of zulrah scales in reserve!
